mapper.select: SELECT metric_name AS metric_name, window_type AS window_type, watermark_at AS watermark_at, updated_at AS updated_at FROM rag_metric_aggregation_watermark ORDER BY metric_name, window_type

SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, knowledge_base_ids_json AS knowledge_base_ids_json, created_at AS created_at, query_type AS query_type, retrieval_mode AS retrieval_mode, llm_model AS llm_model, embedding_model AS embedding_model, status AS status, prompt_tokens AS prompt_tokens, completion_tokens AS completion_tokens, total_tokens AS total_tokens, estimated_total_cost AS estimated_total_cost, latency_ms AS latency_ms FROM rag_query_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL)

SELECT l.tenant_id AS tenant_id, l.knowledge_base_ids_json AS knowledge_base_ids_json, f.created_at AS created_at, l.retrieval_mode AS retrieval_mode, l.query_type AS query_type, f.id AS feedback_id, f.query_log_id AS query_log_id, f.rating AS rating, f.feedback_status AS feedback_status, f.assignee AS assignee FROM rag_query_feedback f JOIN rag_query_log l ON l.id = f.query_log_id WHERE f.created_at >= #{from} AND f.created_at < #{to} AND (l.is_deleted = 0 OR l.is_deleted IS NULL)

SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, created_at AS created_at, provider AS provider, model AS model, api_key_hash AS api_key_hash, error_code_normalized AS error_code_normalized, degraded_reason AS degraded_reason, success AS success, fallback AS fallback, retry_count AS retry_count, cache_hit AS cache_hit, total_tokens AS total_tokens, estimated_cost AS estimated_cost, latency_ms AS latency_ms FROM rag_rerank_call_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, bucket_start, window_type, query_type, retrieval_mode, llm_model, embedding_model, status, query_count, success_count, failed_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_total_cost, p50_latency_ms, p90_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{bucketStart}, #{windowType}, #{queryType}, #{retrievalMode}, #{llmModel}, #{embeddingModel}, #{status}, #{queryCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{estimatedTotalCost}, #{p50LatencyMs}, #{p90LatencyMs}, #{p95LatencyMs}, #{p99LatencyMs}, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE query_count = VALUES(query_count), success_count = VALUES(success_count), failed_count = VALUES(failed_count), prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), estimated_total_cost = VALUES(estimated_total_cost), p50_latency_ms = VALUES(p50_latency_ms), p90_latency_ms = VALUES(p90_latency_ms), p95_latency_ms = VALUES(p95_latency_ms), p99_latency_ms = VALUES(p99_latency_ms), updated_at = NOW(3)

INSERT INTO ${table} (tenant_id, bucket_start, window_type, knowledge_base_id, retrieval_mode, query_type, feedback_rating, feedback_status, assignee, query_count, feedback_count, helpful_count, not_helpful_count, correction_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{bucketStart}, #{windowType}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{retrievalMode}, #{queryType}, #{feedbackRating}, #{feedbackStatus}, #{assignee}, #{queryCount}, #{feedbackCount}, #{helpfulCount}, #{notHelpfulCount}, #{correctionCount}, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE query_count = VALUES(query_count), feedback_count = VALUES(feedback_count), helpful_count = VALUES(helpful_count), not_helpful_count = VALUES(not_helpful_count), correction_count = VALUES(correction_count), updated_at = NOW(3)

INSERT INTO ${table} (tenant_id, bucket_start, window_type, provider, model, api_key_hash, error_code, degraded_reason, request_count, success_count, failure_count, fallback_count, retry_count, cache_hit_count, total_tokens, estimated_cost, p50_latency_ms, p90_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{bucketStart}, #{windowType}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{apiKeyHash}, #{errorCode}, #{degradedReason}, #{requestCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{fallbackCount}, #{retryCount}, #{cacheHitCount}, #{totalTokens}, #{estimatedCost}, #{p50LatencyMs}, #{p90LatencyMs}, #{p95LatencyMs}, #{p99LatencyMs}, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_count = VALUES(request_count), success_count = VALUES(success_count), failure_count = VALUES(failure_count), fallback_count = VALUES(fallback_count), retry_count = VALUES(retry_count), cache_hit_count = VALUES(cache_hit_count), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), estimated_cost = VALUES(estimated_cost), p50_latency_ms = VALUES(p50_latency_ms), p90_latency_ms = VALUES(p90_latency_ms), p95_latency_ms = VALUES(p95_latency_ms), p99_latency_ms = VALUES(p99_latency_ms), updated_at = NOW(3)

INSERT INTO rag_metric_aggregation_watermark(metric_name, window_type, watermark_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{metric}, 'ALL', #{watermark}, NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE watermark_at = VALUES(watermark_at), updated_at = NOW(3)
